caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) with inference-based methods (x-axis) applied to -trained (Ours) and Standard instruction-tuned models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets, comparing inference-based methods applied to models trained with the proposed approach ("Ours") versus standard instruction-tuned models ("Standard"). The horizontal axis displays three categories: "Base," "CORG," and "AdaCAD," representing different model configurations or training strategies. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 48 to 62, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. For each category on the x-axis, two stacked bars are shown: a gray segment representing the "Standard" method and a blue segment on top representing the "Ours" method. In the "Base" category, the "Ours" method achieves a performance of approximately 59.2. In the "CORG" category, the "Standard" method shows a performance of about 51.2, while the "Ours" method reaches approximately 59.6. For the "AdaCAD" category, the "Standard" method performs at around 53.2, and the "Ours" method achieves a performance of approximately 60.2. The chart indicates that the "Ours" method consistently outperforms the "Standard" method across all three configurations.
